description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves GRIMNAR'S COMMAND (Saga of the Great Wolf, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The player ends the Command phase with real clicks (Phase action -> End Command Phase); command_phase_main opens with one button per unit and doctrine ('Grey Hunters Beta: Assault Doctrine (1 CP)'); a real click spends 1 CP and makes the Assault Doctrine active for Grey Hunters B only (flags.sw11e_doctrine / sw11e_doctrine_expires_player, read through SWCommon.doctrine_active); the window is offered again with BIRTH OF A SAGA (GRIMNAR'S COMMAND once per phase) and is declined with a real click.
